rationale: Document the shared OSS contract used by NEWERP/NEWAPP so later upload/download work reuses the same bucket and object-key conventions without exposing long-lived credentials to mobile clients.
validation_focus: Read configuration names and existing NEWERP/NEWAPP code conventions only; never record AccessKeySecret or other secret values.
Perform no OSS write/delete/upload operation and no destructive external action.
Document endpoint/bucket binding by configuration key name, object-key prefix/naming conventions when discoverable, and the server-side signed-ticket boundary.
Produce docs/SHARED_OSS_CONTRACT.md plus a value-safe generated artifact and focused tests.
risks: Do not invent object-key conventions that are not discoverable.
Do not introduce a second OSS bucket or synchronization layer.
Mobile Flutter/ArkTS packages must never receive long-lived OSS credentials.
